title: Mask Adoption Simulation
description: Simulate how individuals adopt mask-wearing over time under the influence of social networks, policies, media, and supply constraints.

interactions.name: peer_influence
interactions.description: Individuals observe peers’ mask use in their social network and update adoption propensity via social learning.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement
interactions.description: Locations and authorities enforce mask mandates; noncompliance may result in reminders or fines, affecting future compliance.

interactions.name: mask_purchase
interactions.description: Individuals buy masks from retailers subject to inventory and price; stockouts or high prices reduce adoption.

interactions.name: information_exposure
interactions.description: Media channels disseminate messages that modify perceived risk and trust, influencing adoption decisions.

interactions.name: norm_observation_in_locations
interactions.description: Individuals observe mask prevalence at visited locations; higher observed prevalence increases adoption via normative conformity.

interactions.name: household_sharing
interactions.description: Household members share mask stock and reinforce household norms affecting individual decisions.

metrics.name: overall_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of individuals consistently wearing masks per day and cumulatively.

metrics.name: time_to_50_percent_adoption
metrics.description: Number of days until overall adoption rate first reaches 50%.

metrics.name: peak_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Maximum observed daily adoption rate over the simulation.

metrics.name: location_specific_adoption
metrics.description: Average mask-wearing rate observed within each location type.

metrics.name: adoption_disparity_index
metrics.description: Difference in adoption rates across demographics (e.g., income or age groups).

metrics.name: enforcement_events
metrics.description: Total number of enforcement warnings/fines issued.

metrics.name: stockout_frequency
metrics.description: Proportion of retailer-days with zero mask inventory.

metrics.name: average_price_paid
metrics.description: Mean price per mask paid by individuals over the simulation.

metrics.name: mask_demand_supply_ratio
metrics.description: Ratio of mask units demanded to units available over time.

metrics.name: average_perceived_risk
metrics.description: Mean perceived risk level across individuals over time.

validation_criteria.name: adoption_curve_convergence
validation_criteria.description: Adoption rate change is below a small threshold (e.g., <0.5 percentage points) over the final 14 days.

validation_criteria.name: mandate_effect_direction
validation_criteria.description: Adoption rate in the 14 days after mandate start exceeds the 14 days before by a positive margin.

validation_criteria.name: bounded_stockouts
validation_criteria.description: Stockout frequency remains below an acceptable threshold (e.g., <20%) for plausibility.
